tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Call this first. Returns one topic of Jabbertoon's guide as Markdown (under 20,000 characters): start (what it makes and the order of calls), cartoon (the JSON program: cast, scenes, lines, moves), text (the same cartoon as screenplay text), moves, characters, looks, voices, places, errors, limits.

tools.name: list_moves
tools.description: Lists the ready-made moves a character can do (walk in, wave hello, hop, bow, slump, talk...): id, name, length in seconds, the bodies it works on (two legs, four, none), its settings with units, page and links. A does block plays one: {"op": "does", "who": "dog", "behaviour": "c4c:beh:wave_hello"}.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: Lists the six ready-made characters (person, kid, dog, cat, bird, monster): legs, views, the colour slots a cast entry's look.colors paints on each (a dog's fur is skin), options, page and links; the voices a line can use; and cartoon_example, a whole talking cartoon to copy. Call it to write a cast

tools.name: list_looks
tools.description: Lists the six art styles a character can be drawn in (flat, outlined, soft, storybook, bold, crayon), each with its page and a studio link, and the three body shapes (classic, big head, tall). A cast entry sets them as look.style and look.shape: {"look": {"template": "cat", "style": "crayon", "shape

tools.name: get_move
tools.description: Returns one ready-made move: its block program as JSON, the same program as screenplay text, its length in seconds, what it works on, its settings with units, its page and links. Name it by id (c4c:beh:wave_hello), short name (wave_hello) or page slug. To write your own move, start from one, change

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Checks a cartoon, with the studio's own checks, before anyone sees it. Give one of cartoon, program, pack, character or file. Returns errors (it will not play as written: also a character or background the site lacks) and warnings, each {code, where, says, fix, url}, with did_you_mean and an RFC 690

tools.name: share_link
tools.description: Turns a cartoon, a scene, a move or a character into a jabbertoon.com link: a move opens in the block editor, the rest in the studio. It all travels after the #: nothing is uploaded or kept. All but a character's end with &from=ai (the page says an AI helper wrote it). One with errors gets them inst

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Tells the people who make Jabbertoon something is wrong: a wrong answer, a check that refused a good cartoon or passed a bad one, a move that looks wrong, a link that does not open, wrong docs, or something missing. Unlike the other tools, it keeps what you send: the report (kind, tool, code, where,

findings.detail: Tool "report_problem" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
